horoscopes.horoscope: The artist in you seeks expression today. Thus, you could decide to paint your house in attractive colours, or repair a piece of old furniture in modern style. You may become sentimental about a forgotten matchbox collection, and decide to replenish it. Ganesha is in full agreement with all such activities that give you fulfilment. Good news is awaiting for people who wants to spice up their love life. Committed Arians might want to do anything for their love. Feeling for your sweetheart is the most important thing that blossoms your romance. Be so strong that nobody can snatch your love, advises Ganesha. It’s not a day with great energy but it’s neither a dull day either. Ganesha feels that today, you will be contributing your best to the work but in the second half of the day, you will need to relax for awhile. You will be content what you have in on the financial front. You will not be too concerned about working hard to earn some extra money. Plan out outstation trips to save money. You may easily pass the first half of the day but during the second half, files will just pile up on your desk. Communication is on the cards, with your Inbox overflowing with mails. You need to pull up your socks, says Ganesha.

A good day for money and love (you need more?). A quality, professional approach will help you shine out in business today. Be it launching a product or marketing it, you will win yourself hearts, smiles and a bundle of green. Let the leader in you take over during the day and the lover in you return by night, says Ganesha. Emotional connection will bring you closer to your loved one. Your flair for art, painting or a soft old romantic songs can turn your sweetheart on. Avoid discussing any domestic issues or difficulties at least on this special day, suggests Ganesha. You will need to gather your divided energies and must align your thoughts in such a way that you are able to work in a focussed manner. Physical health and mental health are equally important, this is what you are going to realise today. You will be happy to earn money from unexpected avenues. Old sources may also present themselves strongly so that will give you sense of security. Plan for future expenses in the evening. With today’s planetary alignment, harmony should prevail in your love life as well. Dress up, fill a bottle of red wine and enchant your lover with your true beauty. Stimulate your lover with your sparkling almond shaped eyes and honey filled voice

There are indications that your aggressive spirit and antagonistic trait will come to the fore today, says Ganesha. This may have a negative effect, but today you can even get away with murder! You will, in fact, get much-awaited good news at the workplace. At home, you will be at your playful and imaginative best. Love is blind, they say, and today you will not be able to see anyone other than your loved one. You will be completely devoted to your sweetheart and able to fulfill whatever you have promised him/her. Chill out as special plans are likely to get implemented. Make the most of this vibrant day – properly channelise your energy and prudently utilise your time to taste success in your endeavours. As the days ends, you will easily accomplish all tasks and celebrate your success with loved ones. During second half of the day, you stand chance of getting temporal financial benefit too. You should work on short term financial planning today because working on long term would prove to be futile exercise. You may feel like a traveler lost in the wilderness when you wake up in the morning, but don’t worry, this is just a hangover from a bad dream. You’ll see it for yourself when you have a smooth ride in the office today. In meetings, your focus will be only on your targets.

The health of a kin may cause anxiety, says Ganesha. Your lack of enthusiasm will influence you on family matters. So you will have to focus on family members. New ties and contacts are in the offing. Over-all, a hectic and profit-able day. Be forthright with your lover today. If you don’t listen to the heart of your loved one, you need to pay the price. Be ready to compromise, suggests Ganesha. Once issues get sorted out, you both will indulge in a wonderful romance. Overflowing with exuberance and energy, no task will appear to be hard or daunting to accomplish. This day is ideal to focus on important tasks in the personal and professional sphere. Don’t get frustrated by some hurdles – jump over them. Ganesha feels that while this may burn a hole in your pocket, you will still not be very worried because you will have savings for rainy days. If not, just be careful and control your buying impulse. Your emotional radar will reverberate with high-frequency today. Noon may find you in a Catch-22 situation. However, as far as your career is concerned, things should clear up later in the day. You need to finish the important projects first as you may be occupied with meetings in the second half.

You will be in the mood to express your thoughts and opinions unabashedly today. You will try your utmost to make gains in your profession. You will be able to clear off your debts. You should make the most of this beneficial time to end your financial troubles, says Ganesha. If you are having any confusion, just get it sorted out with your partner. You will have a fantastic romance throughout the night, foresees Ganesha. You will eventually feel the magic inside once you discover the propensity with your lover, feels Ganesha. The workload may be very heavy today, but it will not bother you, as you shall feel very zealous since morning. However, as the day progresses your energy level may move downwards, and your tired body may demand some rest. Although the day doesn’t look very bad for financial matters, Ganesha fears that you may end up spending more than your pocket permits. You should hold all investment plans today as they are not likely to work in your favour today. You may feel rather upset and show this at the meetings with superiors or colleagues. As the dusk approaches, there will be a dramatic change in your thoughts and your jovial nature will amaze everyone. Your power to motivate others will be at its peak, foresees Ganesha.

Perhaps, your artistic talents will shine out today, says Ganesha. You will be very happy with your personal belongings, which you have preserved for years. Later in the day, you may beautify your house by adding furniture and artefacts at appropriate places. Opening up to your love mate will help you reach newer levels of intimacy. Boost your confidence and get armed with all the necessary romantic weapons to help him/her get closer to you. Your sympathy, honesty, and obedience might cause your sweetheart fell in love with you. On this fantastic day, your efficiency is going to soar. This will not only surprise one and all in your office, but also help you to win accolades from your superiors. Needless to say – evening shall be party time! Money may be spent on friends, family, further development of business, branding, publicity, pleasure and leisure. You will remain calculative and may not spend much beyond your budget. As the day starts, you’ll feel tensed and devoid of focus. However, very soon, you’ll chide yourself for being off your rocker, because you’ll realise there wasn’t anything to worry about. By banishing all negative thoughts and distractions, you’ll aim for the bull’s eye and finish all your work.

Ganesha says today you will like to do something special in a subject that interests you. Past incidents or memories will flash in your mind today. Today you will be able to tell what is in your heart and mind to a special person. Ganesha wishes you a happy and joyous day. Love life will be more or less harmonious and free of hassles. You will feel happy thinking that you have won the heart of your prince or princess. You may dive into the fantasy driven romantic world where you want to live peacefully. Today your approach is likely to be very accommodative. As a result, your energy level will be maintained and you shall not get exhausted, physically or mentally. Your coworkers and family members will also help you to complete your tasks. You will then not have time to think about money as work will be your priority. Ganesha suggests you to remain focused on work, money will follow. It’s a good day to take decision like starting a business. At work, you will show enthusiasm today. However, routine communications may eat away most of your time before lunch. Though you may attain some success in the second-half of the day, Ganesha warns you not to brow-beat as it will make the situation bitter.

It’s time for soiree and merry making with family, predicts Ganesha. You never know, you may even bump into someone special today, who may become an integral part of your life in future. Your friends are your extended family, call them over for the celebrations. If you are single, then you may want to propose that special someone today. If you are already in love, then go ahead and dazzle your lover with your naughty tricks. However, you need to be extra sentimental to his or her feeling. Apologise if you have hurt, suggests Ganesha. The stars suggest that you need to take extra care of your health today. If possible, take a leave to rest your tired muscles and brain. Those who are middle-aged and above, must go for a routine medical check-up. During second half of the day, you may remain lucky in case of money matters. You may see work/business/money flowing in through expected and unexpected sources. Do not push your luck in the first half of the day. Today, you will challenge yourself. You will be at your competitive best and desire to be in the limelight. In fact, you will be driven by the aura of success and achievement. You may not get everything instantly. You need to wait, feels Ganesha.

Ganesha foresees a gradual weakening in your position. You are most likely to bring troubles upon yourself as the day progresses. Good economic gains are expected if you change the hub of your activities. A new dimension in your love life will bring more than a smile to your face. You will feel happy after a long time thinking that you have got the kind of a partner you are looking for. Try to be practical in love, suggests Ganesha. On this very boring day, you are likely to feel very dull. After completing your daily routine, you must do some interesting in the evening to regain your good mood. Have dinner at your favourite restaurant with your dear ones. You will be paying more attention to what you have accumulated till now and what more you will need in order to have more financial ‘freedom’. Your free flow of life must not be restricted by financial problems. You should eat an extra slice of bread for your breakfast today as Ganesha feels that the workload in office is going to be back-breaking. You may find flaws in your colleagues’ work which you should avoid on your own, reminds Ganesha. You need to revise carefully before submitting any crucial tasks, feels Ganesha.

Nothing in the world can be as comforting as the support of your family members, and you will have that in plenty today, especially if you’re setting out to refurbish your house, says Ganesha. With their support, you can win the world and achieve the impossible, but since everything comes with a price tag — even happiness— get ready to pay for a fat bill; the support of your loved ones won’t come cheap. For that brief period when you are with your lover, you will forget your tensions and relax in his or her arms. As you are looking for a long term commitment, discussing some important personal matters and future will help your lover pay attention to you, feels Ganesha. Some challenging issues in the professional and personal sphere may adversely affect your health. You are likely to feel very anxious and tired, especially during the first half of today. Spend more time for leisure and entertainment in the evening. Your thinking will be directed towards new sources of income. You might want to increase the sources of income or you may need to put in more efforts in existing work. Good business connections need to be developed. Though the day will start on a positive note, you may feel later that your efforts were not in the right direction. Review your work and rectify mistakes as soon as possible or before anyone else finds them. You may have to rely on others in the matter of crucial decision.

Fame and fortune woo you today! And along with recognitions and rewards, you receive encouragement to do even better. Your bosses are pleased, but feel that you haven’t really given your 100%. Head on your shoulders and feet on the ground, says Ganesha, is the best policy. The evening will sound exotic when you plan to spend an amazing time with your sweetheart in an eco-friendly resort. You don’t need to be prepared to get unlimited surprises from your partner who loves to thrill, chill, and excite you, says Ganesha. After working extra hours during the past few days, your health may deteriorate today. You should therefore pay full attention to your well-being, and avoid overstraining your mind and body. Also eat well and sleep well to maintain good health. Health and related matters may eat a chunk from your pocket, if you are not careful. In other words, during second half of the day, medical expenses are foreseen. This is going to be an average day for money matters. You may remain on your toes till lunch today. Ganesha will be happy to see that your focus will only be on your goals. Keep your cool and concentrate on the task at hand. Avoid neglecting any of your team members, reminds Ganesha.

For professionals as well as businessmen, today promises to be a progressive day. For those looking for new opportunities, interesting positions may be offered. You will have harmonious relations with your family, friends and co-workers. A progressive period for you begins from today, says Ganesha. You may remain sensitive about some domestic issues in the morning. This will be your primary concern throughout the day. As the darkness falls, you will be able to manage your emotional stress as the moral support from your partner will make you feel stress-free. On this lackluster day, you are advised to take good care of your health and well-being. Although the work atmosphere may be uncongenial, you should remain composed. Your opponents may try to find faults and tarnish your image – just control yourself. How about buying musical instruments, some books and a cup of coffee at a peaceful area; sit, read, write and relax? Alternatively, you may spend money behind musical show or a movie. Fortunately, your mind will be preoccupied with work-related issues. The upshot will be positive, says Ganesha. You will perfectly boss a job and provides necessary instructions. Your creative ideas and strategies will fetch positive results and boost professional image, feels Ganesha.
